medicine-1095-4565.masters: A 6-12 month project: reproduce one recent deep reinforcement learning study and one recent tradeoff study, then run a focused experiment combining the two through hot spot, reporting what transfers and what does not.
medicine-1095-4565.industry: Illustrative example only (no claim about the firm's actual work): an industry research team such as Marshall Wace could run a short feasibility study testing whether combining deep reinforcement learning with tradeoff via hot spot adds measurable value to an existing medicine pipeline, then decide whether to invest further.
